visits.accuracy: Browser and tab IDs are anonymous storage identifiers, not people. Shared networks can share an IP; clearing storage, private browsing and duplicated tabs affect IDs. Blocked JavaScript, blocked requests, offline visits and rate-limited traffic may not be counted. Browser/device data is reported or inferred from User-Agent and can be spoofed.
